goal: Allow authenticated read-only real-time observation of every super-planning job under a project.
architectureSummary: Dedicated Node 18 built-in dashboard server plus Bash lifecycle helper; snapshots derive from super-plan registries and progress logs, with secure HTTP/WebSocket delivery and no jobs-root writes.
globalConstraints: Preserve canonical lifecycle strings and never mutate files below the selected jobs root.
Use Node.js 18 built-in modules only; add no package-install step or external CDN.
Emit exactly one detached-start JSON object to stdout; send diagnostics to stderr.
Require token or strict session cookie for all HTTP and WebSocket job data, and same-origin validation for upgrades.
Display only project-relative jobs-root paths and render job text as literal text.
Apply TDD to behavior changes using docs/context/testing-anti-patterns.md.
The user authorized implementation directly on main without a worktree.

fileStructure.notes: Bash start/stop lifecycle, authenticated health verification, and owner-only per-project state.
Node 18 built-in authenticated HTTP/WebSocket snapshot server.
Dependency-free dashboard rendering, local filtering, and connection state.
Sequentially owned integration, distribution, static, and regression coverage.
Accepted-to-implemented closure metadata and verification results.

requirementsChecklist.title: Provide the documented dashboard lifecycle helper and safe single-instance runtime state.

acceptanceCriteria: Detached startup prints one connection JSON object

requirementsChecklist.title: Protect every HTTP and WebSocket surface with the token, strict session cookie, and same-origin upgrade checks.
requirementsChecklist.source: accepted spec: Authentication and network behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthorized requests reveal no registry data
Key bootstrap redirects to a token-free URL
Cross-origin upgrades fail before registration

requirementsChecklist.title: Aggregate valid registries and progress logs into the versioned snapshot envelope without changing CLI summary behavior.
requirementsChecklist.source: accepted spec: Snapshot and update behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Empty roots are valid
Task events are chronological, capped at 200, and retain full eventCount
Display paths remain jobs-root relative

requirementsChecklist.title: Broadcast only changed snapshots and retain last valid data while malformed registry or JSONL input recovers.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated sockets receive an initial snapshot and one changed update
Warnings identify malformed relative paths
Recovered input removes its warning

requirementsChecklist.title: Render a dependency-free responsive overview and detail dashboard with local filters and literal job text.
requirementsChecklist.source: accepted spec: Dashboard presentation; Edge case 15
acceptanceCriteria: Overview, status counts, warnings, connection state, task detail and filters are present
Registry and log strings are inserted as text rather than executable HTML

requirementsChecklist.title: Distribute and document the dashboard consistently in vendored and bootstrapped layouts.
acceptanceCriteria: Bootstrap and update copy all dashboard files without removing runtime state
Doctor validates dashboard dependencies and manifest
SKILL route, README, build and tests remain aligned

rules: super-plan.json is orchestrator-owned; workers do not edit it directly.
Tasks run sequentially and receive per-batch independent review.
Task reports contain command output and TDD RED/GREEN evidence when required.
Use rtk as the workspace command prefix.
The requested profile configuration is gpt-5.6-luna: deep/high, general/medium, quick/medium; platform dispatch uses its default agent when no explicit selector is available.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated real-time job dashboard runtime
tasks.description: Create the independent Node 18 job dashboard helper, server, and dependency-free browser surface. Use real temporary jobs fixtures and sockets to prove the accepted lifecycle, authorization, snapshot, live-update, and malformed-input behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Focused dashboard tests are observed RED while the helper is absent, then GREEN against a real local server process.
serve-jobs.sh implements the accepted arguments, one-JSON stdout contract, authenticated health verification, owner-only runtime metadata, duplicate reuse, foreground mode, and safe idempotent stop.

server.cjs uses Node built-ins only, produces the accepted snapshot envelope, reads no paths outside the jobs root, never mutates the jobs root, retains last valid data on malformed files, and broadcasts only changed snapshots.

HTTP, cookie bootstrap, restrictive headers, WebSocket authentication/origin checks, responsive DOM UI, filters, literal text rendering, and connection state satisfy the accepted security and presentation contracts.

The focused dashboard suite verifies startup, authentication, empty and multiple registries, update delivery, malformed registry/JSONL recovery, event cap, injection safety, occupied ports, stale PID safety, and clean shutdown.
rules: TDD required for this behavior-changing task.
Read docs/context/testing-anti-patterns.md before creating fixtures or test-only helpers.
Use real file fixtures, HTTP requests, WebSocket frames, and child processes; do not mock the dashboard server or filesystem contract.
Keep stdout parseable; diagnostics and warnings go to stderr.
Do not add packages, CDNs, mutation endpoints, or dashboard-only lifecycle states.
Write RED and GREEN commands, output, and expected failure reason to the task report.

steps.title: Add failing integration coverage
steps.description: Add a focused dashboard-only test section using minimal temporary project, registry, progress log, and socket fixtures. Run it before implementing the helper and record the missing-runtime failure.
steps.expectedResult: Fails because job-dashboard helper/server behavior is absent

steps.title: Implement lifecycle helper
steps.description: Create serve-jobs.sh with argument validation, canonical project/jobs roots, secure per-project state, launch/reuse, authenticated health check, optional opener warning, and PID instance proof for stop.

steps.title: Implement secure snapshot server
steps.description: Create server.cjs with built-in HTTP and RFC 6455 support, token/cookie authorization, headers, filesystem-signature scanning, snapshot cache/retention/warnings, and authenticated broadcasts.

steps.title: Implement browser dashboard
steps.description: Add local CSS and JavaScript that render metrics, plan/task details, filters, warnings, timelines, and connection state using textContent rather than HTML injection.
steps.expectedResult: All focused runtime and browser-security assertions pass

steps.title: Report TDD evidence
steps.description: Run the focused suite again after self-review, preserve exact results in report.md, and do not alter distribution helpers owned by later tasks.
steps.expectedResult: GREEN evidence is complete and output is clean

tasks.title: Distribute dashboard helpers through bootstrap, update, and doctor
tasks.description: Extend the existing complete helper manifest so a bootstrapped project receives the same dashboard runtime, updater refreshes it without deleting runtime state, and doctor validates the dashboard-specific prerequisites and files.
acceptanceCriteria: Bootstrap copies every job-dashboard file to the flat manifest and keeps permissions usable.
super-update refreshes each dashboard file in both nested and flat layouts without deleting unrelated job-dashboard runtime metadata.
doctor.sh --dashboard validates Node and every dashboard manifest file while preserving existing --visual behavior.
Focused tests demonstrate both vendored and bootstrapped resolution paths start the dashboard successfully.
rules: TDD required for manifest and helper behavior.
Read docs/context/testing-anti-patterns.md before adding fixture helpers.
Extend existing manifest loops and layout conventions instead of introducing a second bootstrap format.
Do not delete files outside the explicitly managed helper manifest.
Record RED and GREEN command evidence in the task report.

steps.title: Add failing manifest assertions
steps.description: Extend focused integration coverage to require dashboard files from bootstrap, update, doctor, and flat-layout startup before modifying the helper scripts.
steps.expectedResult: Fails because dashboard files are absent from the distribution manifests

steps.title: Extend updater manifest

steps.title: Add dashboard doctor checks

steps.title: Run focused distribution GREEN suite

tasks.title: Verify integration and close dashboard delivery
tasks.description: Run the accepted focused, complete, syntax, gitignore, package test, and build checks after implementation; resolve integration defects within scope and update the spec verification metadata with the real delivery paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Every Definition of Done command is run and its output recorded.
Any in-scope integration defect found by full checks is fixed with focused regression evidence.
The accepted spec gains exact implemented paths and verification results only after all checks pass.
rules: Do not mark the spec implemented or the task complete before independent review and all Definition of Done checks pass.
Report any unrelated pre-existing failure with its command and evidence rather than masking it.
Keep fixes narrow and preserve the accepted read-only scope.

steps.title: Run focused dashboard verification
steps.description: Run the accepted dashboard-only suite, shell syntax check, Node syntax check, and gitignore contract.
steps.command: SUPER_PLANNING_JOB_DASHBOARD_ONLY=1 bash skills/super-planning/dev/tests.sh && bash -n skills/super-planning/scripts/job-dashboard/serve-jobs.sh && node --check skills/super-planning/scripts/job-dashboard/server.cjs && bash src/tests/gitignore.sh
steps.expectedResult: All focused Definition of Done checks exit 0
